text:
Tonight, is our FINAL training night of the winter cross country and road season! Can you believe it??? 
We will be having a fun session, with prizes.... 👀

Looking forward to seeing you all! Following this, we will have our between seasons break, then starting back again for our summer track sprints, running and walks season on October 5th at Ashgrove Park - Will also send reminders as we get closer to this date. See you all soon! 🏃‍♀️🏃💪

Open day is coming up! We welcome all new, old and existing members to come and train on our open nights, see if it fits, see if you enjoy it. No sign up required. We ask parents to stick around to learn what its all about and hear the talk from our manager. We also welcome parents to help out, however they can. We look forward to seeing you there!
